evidence.evidence_text: Our approach tackles two primary challenges in variational summarization: insufficient semantic information in latent representations and posterior collapse during training.
Our approach tackles two primary challenges in variational summarization: insufficient semantic information in latent representations and posterior collapse during training.

To address these challenges, we employ normalizing flows to enable flexible latent posterior modeling, and we propose a controlled alternate aggressive training (CAAT) strategy with an improved gate mechanism.
